description: Multi-model TWO-LEG: the TELEMON_MOVE_ISSUE board plus a real 3-model Thunderwolf Cavalry squad (MOUNTED, 60mm, no FLY — so 11e dense terrain over 2" blocks it) at (1480,760). Heading 120 deg / 14" its straight line is blocked by generator-15. The planner sweeps EVERY model's base, plans one shared dogleg (7" at 60 deg, then on), places the squad as a rigid block, and AIPlayer stages all three waypoints (sidestep order) then all three destinations; the engine confirms the move with every model exactly on its planned spot. Also pins the MovementPhase stage validator measuring path-summed distance + per-segment terrain (T-082) — it used to charge the straight origin->dest line's climb over the generator the models went around (14.3" > 12"). The planner is called directly toward that heading (the AI's own pick for this squad is an Advance-to-charge whose line is not blocked).

steps.comment: plan -> 3 waypoints -> AIPlayer stages via waypoints -> CONFIRM accepted -> every model on its planned destination
